origin.description: Fits quantile regression on L(), d(), trend(), and season() terms of a ts series, with the Barrodale-Roberts point estimate. Checked for the default method and for start and end, not for other methods.
origin.details: Fits quantile regression on L(), d(), trend(), and season() terms of a ts series, with the Barrodale-Roberts point estimate. Checked for the default method and for start and end, not for other methods.
origin.value: coefficients, residuals, and rho of single and multi-tau dynamic fits
origin.example:
a <- dynrq(uk ~ L(uk, 1) + L(uk, 12))
d3 <- dynrq(uk ~ L(uk, 1) + L(uk, 12), tau = 1:3/4)
se <- dynrq(uk ~ L(uk, 1) + L(uk, 12), start = c(1975, 1), end = c(1982, 12))
fm <- dynrq(ap ~ trend(ap) + season(ap), tau = 1:4/5)
